chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ismail ibn Jabir, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'What do you say regarding the food of the People of the Book?' He said, 'Do not eat it.' Then he was silent for a moment, then said, 'Do not eat it.' Then he was silent for a moment, then said, 'Do not eat it, and do not leave it saying that it is forbidden, but leave it turning away from it, for in their vessels is wine and the flesh of the swine.'

key_terms.طَعَامُ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ: Food of the People of the Book

ai.seo_question: Why should Muslims avoid eating the food of the People of the Book according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the prohibition is not intrinsic to the food itself but is a precautionary measure (tanzuhan) to avoid ritual impurity, as their vessels often contain wine or pork. This ruling highlights the Shia distinction between inherent impurity (najis) and ritual avoidance (makhruj), emphasizing practical hygiene and spiritual purity over strict dietary exclusion.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ismail Bin Jabir who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding the food of the People of the Book?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not eat it’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> was silent for a while, then said: ‘Do not eat it’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> was silent for a while, then said: ‘Do not eat it, and do not leave it saying that it is Prohibited, but leave it turning away from it if in their vessels is the wine and the flesh of the swine’.
en.sarwar: 9. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from ’Isma‘il ibn Jabir who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the people of the book and what he (the Imam) says about their food. He (the Imam) said, ‘Do not eat it.’ He (the Imam) then remained quiet then said, ‘Do not eat it’ He (the Imam) then remained quiet then said, ‘Do not eat it and do not leave it. Say that it is unlawful, however, you can leave to abstain thereof because in their utensils there is wine and flesh of pigs.’”
